Name: AHCuteArt Portraits for Maggs Seasonal Sebastian - Inspired by Nyapu
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[b][size=5][center]AHCuteArt Portraits for Maggs Emo Sebastian Seasonal Outfits Sprites and Portraits[/center][/size][/b]
[b][size=5]
[/size][/b]
I love drawing pixel portraits for SDV. This mod was requested by 'Faun', who commissioned me to finish this mod above all the others I am working on. I don't feel right taking profit using someone else's artwork-- so, I decided to draw these in my style. I tried to draw these portraits similar to chibi-style that Nyapu and Dong are known for, but I also wanted to make Seb handsome. So these are the portraits I came up with. I hope you all enjoy them. 


[b]INSTALLATION NEEDS (Must have Smapi):
[/b]
1. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30023]Maggs Emo Sebastian Seasonal Outfits Sprites, and Portraits[/url] 
2. ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 
3. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28284]Cross-Mod Compatibility Tokens[/url]﻿
4. ﻿Make sure to go into GMCM to "Maggs Emo Sebastian Sprites"  to edit Sebastian the way you want. 

[b]Compatibility:
Vanilla, SVE, RSV, Maggs, Nyapu, and any portrait that doesn't edit Sebastian or has an option to turn their portrait edit off in GMCM

I am a newbie CP coder and trying to teach myself how to do this as I go. Unfortunately, with so many options for this portrait mod, I couldn't test them all. If you find a bug, please let me know (and pray that I'll figure out how to fix it. LOL)[/b]
[b]
[/b][i][b]CREDITS:[/b]
Thank you, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url], for always helping me with my coding questions and for helping me with the bugs in my code.
Thank you, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/201103991]MaggPlays[/url] for allowing me to edit the portraits of your mod and for the amazing mod itself. There are so many options!
I am grateful to 'Faun', who commissioned me and allowed me to post this mod for all of you. 
A special thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34250790]spacechase0[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/177615852]Spiderbuttons[/url] , who made mods to make modding easier for all of us.

[b]
[/b][i]If you're curious what I am working on next, please check out my social media pages (@AhCuteArt) or my Nexus profile. I update weekly.[/i][/i]
